patthana9.16:1.1: vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na adukkhama sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na
patthana9.16:4.1: na saraṇaṃ na vipāka dhammadhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na neva vipāka
patthana9.16:6.1: na saraṇaṃ na upādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana9.16:7.1: na saraṇaṃ na anupādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
